verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair privacy question for a SaaS accounting product like FreshBooks, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions telemetry, analytics opt-out, cookie or tracking controls, or privacy settings. The OAuth, webhook, and accounting-feature material is about other stories and does not transfer.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
